topic: Durable CQB resume must not manufacture missing progress, settings or spent history
source: CBE legacy incoming resume path, source-to-owner comparison with existing clear-room-producer-boundary-20261026.json; no new upstream function port
findings: cortexClearBuilding resumed failedBy with per-position empty defaults, reset mismatched row counts to empty arrays and substituted serverTime for missing lastProgressAt. Missing hardDeadline/baseAttack/native receipt/route continuation also had live/current defaults.
CortexDiscover indexed _clear select0 before any complete durable-order validation. Public progress records were used as legacy resume preparation, not an authenticated all-writer transfer.
implementation: Pure ClearOrderValid checks the14-field durable shape, finite original clocks/settings, bounded disjoint room indices, sparse spent retries, exact failure rows/lane IDs, native receipt shape, optional contact belief and transform. No mutation, world query or clock renewal.

Actual discovery/startup invokes the helper before indexing/admission, then rechecks failure-history size against actual selected room count. A prior nonempty malformed clear also cannot supply a synthetic behaviour baseline to a fresh replacement.

Resume uses validated original field values directly, removing clock/settings/history fallback and size reset. Sparse retries remain absent, not replenished. Existing native/context/phase/actor settings preflight and command writers retain authority.

Validation deliberately does not enforce stallDeadline<=hardDeadline: actual producer progress may extend stall deadline while the immutable hard boundary is separately enforced. No new clock-skew or expiry guess in pure shape checks.
limits: Not producer authentication, source/native quiescence, server seal or incoming readiness. CANDIDATE_UNSEALED still has no executable consumer.
Complete incoming phase/native/settings reconstruction and transport still required before full handover is claimed.
Physical repeat/HC/JIP/interruption/late data and measured performance remain unverified; auditsPAUSED.
Only structurally complete orders produced by the current14-field publisher are eligible; no first-release legacy fallback is introduced.
cost: Two bounded admission checks plus discovery preflight while an unapplied durable clear exists; <=512 failure/retry rows, eight lane IDs per failure row. No timer, worker or new command writer.
